title_chain.summary_title: 网络社交与伦理学 social networking and ethics (Shannon Vallor)
title_chain.zh_h1: 网络社交与伦理学 social networking and ethics (Shannon Vallor)

spot.html_text: Philosophers of technology often speak of the affordances or gradients of particular technologies in given contexts (Vallor 2010) insofar as they make certain patterns of use more attractive or convenient for users (while not rendering alternative patterns impossible). Thus while I can certainly seek out posts that will cause me discomfort or anxiety, the platform gradient will not be designed to facilitate such experiences. Yet it is not obvious if or when it should be designed to do so. As Ale
